subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.9 QQBot: long markdown reply is split into N independent bubbles (one per chunk), not a single message

question: Should QQBot preserve the current one-message-per-safe-Markdown-chunk behavior, or merge safe chunks into one QQ bubble when the combined payload fits a verified QQ API limit?
rationale: Current main intentionally sends complete Markdown chunks, an open PR proposes merging safe chunks, and a member comment says the split is by design; automation cannot choose the permanent user-visible channel policy.

options.title: Preserve intentional chunking
options.body: Keep the current split behavior to avoid truncation and broken Markdown, then document the policy and close or decline safe-merge PRs.

options.title: Land verified safe merging
options.body: Refresh and review the linked safe-merge PR or a replacement, requiring live proof for within-limit and overflow behavior before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Preserve intentional chunking
recommendation.body: Keep the current split behavior to avoid truncation and broken Markdown, then document the policy and close or decline safe-merge PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: sliverp is listed for QQ/Chinese channels, authored the central chunker work, is assigned on the linked PR, and left the latest by-design comment.
